resources.string: Install an APK on TV
Send one APK you select. Confirm installation separately on your TV.
Back to casting
1. Choose one APK
No APK selected. Ordinary .apk files only, up to 1 GiB. Split APKs, .apks and .xapk bundles are unsupported.
Choose APK
Choose another APK
Retry: choose APK again
2. Choose your TV
On your TV, open MoonCast → Receive APK to start a five-minute receive window. Keep both devices on the same trusted private network.
No TV selected
Selected: %1$s\n%2$s
SHA-256 detects corruption; it does not authenticate a sender. Displayed package and signer details are not a malware scan. Android on the TV makes the final installation and signature checks.
Send APK to selected TV

Choose an APK and TV, review the details, then send.
Copying and checking the private APK copy… %1$s copied
Sending %1$s / %2$s…
Received on TV. This does not mean installed. Review the APK and confirm installation on the TV. The phone’s temporary copy was deleted.
Could not prepare this APK. Choose a complete, signed ordinary .apk, up to 1 GiB, with at least 32 MiB free after copying. Check access and available storage, then select it again.
Transfer cleared when this screen left the foreground. Check TV before retrying, open a new receive window and choose the APK again.
The system document picker is unavailable. Check that a Files app is enabled and try again.
Choose an APK, choose your TV, then send. Confirm installation on the TV. Casting can keep running.
My TV · Choose device
Package and signature details
Unencrypted home-network transfer. Only use a trusted LAN: anyone on it may send a file while TV receiving is enabled, read the APK, or impersonate a TV.
Choose your TV and tap Send. Uploads never restart automatically.
Ready to send. Installation still needs confirmation on TV.
Connecting to TV…
Could not confirm transfer. Check the TV first; it may already have the file. To retry, reopen Receive APK on TV and select the APK again.
Canceled. The temporary APK was cleared.
APK could not be sent
